description: This PHP class, `AttendanceRecordListModel`, represents a model for a list of attendance records within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin API. It serializes attendance data such as punch-in and punch-out times, notes, duration, and formats the data for API responses following OpenAPI schema annotations.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordListModel
classes.description: A model class that represents a list of attendance records, providing serialization to array for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttendanceRecordListModel with an array of attendance records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the attendance records into an array suitable for API output, formatting date/time and calculating duration.
